test_title: PYST 18: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

Option 1) WC – AV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36bcbc88e971f674e00ff96c5f06defa667a2270607f4266a389b716fe065414.png] 

Option 2) DJ – HC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d17810c7f16109f3bcc9c202bf12f5c3381e0cff06bc8f5f67795264ba0b67e9.png] 

Option 3) MS – PL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2493a47ac3a91a3cfd10fbbbdb7cd7ae713da9dcfa3e038864c55257900a120d.png] 

Option 4) FL – JE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ef29f3e462a682e5a3ca5321acfe63a642b69d23ec0ee353adbef51138f6206.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'MS – PL' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
